klipler.istem: The mosquito drifts slowly in the dark air with blurred wings, the moonlight flickers softly through the curtain. Static camera. The mosquito stays small, same shape, 3D animation style preserved, nothing new appears.
The glowing breath plume slowly rises and swirls through the dark room like drifting light. Static camera. 3D animation style preserved, nothing new appears.

The three glowing trails flow slowly toward the mosquito's antennae, the antennae twitch slightly. Static camera, no legs appear. Same head, same shape, 3D animation style preserved, nothing new appears.
